description.ru: Zero conditional: if + present simple, present simple — для фактов и законов природы
description.en: Zero conditional for facts and general truths

data.question: Zero conditional: 'If you ____ water to 100°C, it boils.'
data.hint: Нулевой тип: обе части в Present Simple.
data.explanation: В нулевом условном (общие факты) после if идёт Present Simple: If you heat water, it boils.

data.text: If you mix blue and yellow, you ____ green.
data.hint: Present Simple, факт (3 лицо не нужно — 'you').
data.explanation: Нулевой тип описывает всегда истинный результат: you get green.

data.hint: Соедини условие с всегда истинным результатом.
data.explanation: Нулевой тип: обе части в Present Simple, результат — общая истина.

data.hint: Сначала условие с if, потом результат.
data.explanation: Нулевой тип: If it rains, the ground gets wet — простой факт.

data.transcript: If you press this button, the machine stops.
data.translation: Если ты нажмёшь эту кнопку, машина остановится.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: If you press this button, the machine stops.
If you pressed this button, the machine stopped.
If you press this button, the machine starts.
When you press the button, the machine moves.
data.hint: Слушай глаголы: оба в Present Simple.
data.explanation: Нулевой тип описывает как работает механизм: press → stops.

data.prompt: Say: 'If you study every day, you learn faster.'
data.target: If you study every day, you learn faster.
data.explanation: Нулевой тип: общее правило, которое работает всегда.

description.ru: First conditional: if + present simple, will — реальное будущее
description.en: First conditional for real future situations

data.question: First conditional: 'If it rains tomorrow, we ____ at home.'
data.hint: Реальное будущее: главная часть с will.
data.explanation: Первый тип: If + Present Simple, а результат с will: we will stay.

data.text: If you hurry, you ____ catch the bus.
data.explanation: После if — Present (hurry), в главной части — will catch.

data.question: Переведи: 'Если пойдёт дождь, мы останемся дома.'
expected: If it rains, we will stay at home.
If it rains, we'll stay home.
data.hint: После if — Present Simple, не will.
data.explanation: Первый тип: If it rains (Present), we will stay (will).

data.hint: Условие с if в Present, результат с will.
data.explanation: First conditional: If you help me, I will finish faster.

data.transcript: If I have time, I will call you tonight.
data.translation: Если у меня будет время, я позвоню тебе сегодня вечером.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: If I have time, I will call you tonight.
If I had time, I would call you tonight.
When I have time, I call you tonight.
If I have time, I will text you tomorrow.
data.explanation: Первый тип: реальный план на вечер.

data.prompt: Say: 'If we leave now, we will arrive on time.'
data.target: If we leave now, we will arrive on time.
data.explanation: Первый тип: реальное последствие плана.

description.ru: First conditional со словами when, unless, as soon as
description.en: First conditional with when, unless, as soon as

data.question: 'You'll miss the train ____ you hurry.'
data.explanation: Unless = if not: You'll miss the train unless you hurry = ...if you don't hurry.

data.text: I'll call you as soon as I ____ home.
data.hint: После as soon as — Present Simple, не will.
data.explanation: Во временных придаточных (as soon as, when) о будущем говорят через Present: I get home.
Эти союзы вводят условие или время; после них о будущем — Present Simple.

data.hint: as soon as = как только; после него Present.
data.explanation: I will text you as soon as I arrive — обещание с временным союзом.

data.question: Переведи: 'Если ты не поторопишься, ты опоздаешь.'
expected: If you don't hurry, you'll be late.
Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
data.hint: Можно через if not или unless.
data.explanation: Предупреждение в первом типе: unless you hurry = if you don't hurry.

data.prompt: Say: 'I promise I will help you if you need me.'
data.target: I promise I will help you if you need me.
data.hint: Обещание: will в главной части, Present после if.
data.explanation: Первый тип часто используют для обещаний.

description.ru: Second conditional: if + past simple, would — нереальные ситуации
description.en: Second conditional for unreal or imaginary situations

data.question: Second conditional: 'If I ____ rich, I would travel the world.'
data.hint: Нереальное условие: глагол в Past, с 'to be' — were.
data.explanation: Второй тип: If + Past Simple. С глаголом to be для всех лиц ставят were: If I were rich.

data.text: If I had more time, I ____ learn the guitar.
data.hint: Главная часть второго типа — would + инфинитив.
data.explanation: Гипотетический результат: I would learn. Условие if I had — в Past Simple.
Второй тип: воображаемые ситуации и их гипотетические последствия.

data.hint: Условие в Past, результат с would.
data.explanation: Second conditional: If I had money, I would buy a car — сейчас денег нет.

data.transcript: If I lived by the sea, I would swim every day.
data.translation: Если бы я жил у моря, я бы плавал каждый день.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: If I lived by the sea, I would swim every day.
If I live by the sea, I will swim every day.
When I lived by the sea, I swam every day.
If I lived by the sea, I would walk every day.
data.explanation: Второй тип: воображаемая жизнь у моря.

data.prompt: Say: 'If I had a superpower, I would help people.'
data.target: If I had a superpower, I would help people.
data.explanation: Второй тип: мечта, которая сейчас нереальна.

description.ru: Второй тип для советов: If I were you, I would…
description.en: Using the second conditional to give advice

data.question: Giving advice: 'If I ____ you, I would see a doctor.'
data.explanation: Для совета говорят If I were you (were для всех лиц во втором типе).

data.text: If I were you, I ____ apologize to her.
data.explanation: If I were you, I would apologize — так дают совет.

data.question: Переведи: 'На твоём месте я бы больше отдыхал.'
expected: If I were you, I would rest more.
If I were you, I'd rest more.
data.hint: 'На твоём месте' = If I were you.
data.explanation: Русское 'на твоём месте' по-английски — If I were you.
If I were you, I would take the job — совет принять работу.

data.transcript: If I were you, I would not worry about it.
data.translation: На твоём месте я бы не переживал об этом.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: If I were you, I would not worry about it.
If I was you, I will not worry about it.
If I were you, I would worry about it.
When I were you, I did not worry about it.
data.explanation: Совет в отрицательной форме: I would not worry.

data.prompt: Say: 'If I were you, I would talk to your teacher.'
data.target: If I were you, I would talk to your teacher.
data.explanation: Стандартный способ дать совет во втором типе.

description.ru: Выбор между первым и вторым типом: реальные планы и гипотетические решения
description.en: Choosing between first and second conditional to solve problems

data.question: Real plan: 'If we miss the bus, we ____ a taxi.'
data.explanation: Реальный план на будущее — первый тип: we will take a taxi.

data.text: If I ____ the answer, I would tell you, but I don't.
data.explanation: 'but I don't' показывает, что это второй тип: If I knew the answer.
Первый тип — для реальных решений, второй — для воображаемых.

data.hint: had — Past, work — с would: гипотеза.
data.explanation: Second conditional: If we had more staff, we would work faster.

data.question: Переведи: 'Если проблема останется, мы позвоним в поддержку.'
expected: If the problem stays, we will call support.
If the problem continues, we'll call support.
data.explanation: Реальное будущее решение: If + Present, will call.

data.prompt: Say: 'If we worked together, we would solve this problem.'
data.target: If we worked together, we would solve this problem.
data.hint: worked — Past, solve — с would: гипотеза.
data.explanation: Второй тип предлагает воображаемое решение проблемы.

description.ru: Гипотетические вопросы во втором типе: What would you do if…?
description.en: Hypothetical questions in the second conditional

data.question: 'What would you do if you ____ your job?'
data.explanation: В вопросе второго типа после if — Past: if you lost your job.

data.text: What would happen if everyone ____ electric cars?
data.explanation: Гипотеза: if everyone drove (Past) — а сейчас это не так.

pairs.left: What would you do if you saw a ghost?
Where would you go if you had a week off?
What would you buy if you had 1000 pounds?
Who would you call if you were in trouble?
How would you feel if you won?
What would you say if you met the president?

data.hint: Соедини гипотетический вопрос с логичным ответом.
data.explanation: Вопросы и ответы второго типа: would в обеих частях диалога.

data.hint: Вопрос: What would you do, потом условие с if.
data.explanation: What would you do if you had more free time? — гипотетический вопрос.

data.transcript: If I could speak any language, I would choose Japanese.
data.translation: Если бы я мог говорить на любом языке, я бы выбрал японский.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: If I could speak any language, I would choose Japanese.
If I can speak any language, I will choose Japanese.
If I could speak any language, I would learn Chinese.
When I could speak a language, I chose Japanese.
data.explanation: could + would часто встречаются в гипотезах второго типа.

data.prompt: Say: 'If I could change one thing, I would travel more.'
data.target: If I could change one thing, I would travel more.
data.explanation: Второй тип для воображаемых желаний.

description.ru: Повторение всех трёх типов условных предложений вместе
description.en: Reviewing zero, first and second conditionals together

data.question: 'If water reaches 0°C, it freezes.' Which conditional is this?
data.explanation: Обе части в Present Simple, факт → нулевой (zero) тип.

data.text: If it ____ tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic.
data.hint: После if о будущем — Present Simple.
data.explanation: Первый тип: If it rains (Present), we'll cancel (will).

data.question: Переведи: 'Если бы у меня была карта, я бы не заблудился.'
expected: If I had a map, I wouldn't get lost.
If I had a map, I would not get lost.
data.explanation: Второй тип: If I had a map (Past), I wouldn't get lost (would).

data.hint: Факт → нулевой тип, обе части Present.
data.explanation: Zero conditional: If you mix red and white, you get pink.

data.transcript: If you don't practise, you won't improve.
data.translation: Если ты не будешь заниматься, ты не улучшишься.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: If you don't practise, you won't improve.
If you didn't practise, you wouldn't improve.
If you don't practise, you will improve.
When you practise, you won't improve.
data.hint: Слушай: don't practise и won't improve.
data.explanation: Первый тип с отрицанием: реальное предупреждение.

data.prompt: Say: 'If I had more confidence, I would speak in public.'
data.target: If I had more confidence, I would speak in public.
data.hint: had — Past, speak — с would: второй тип.
data.explanation: Гипотеза о себе во втором типе — хороший итог модуля.

description.ru: Учебные заведения; глаголы с -ing и to
description.en: Places of study; verbs with -ing and to

data.question: I enjoy ____ new subjects at university.
data.explanation: Глаголы enjoy, like, love, hate часто требуют форму -ing: enjoy studying.

data.text: She decided ____ go to university after school.
data.hint: После decide идёт инфинитив с to.
data.explanation: decide to do — принять решение сделать что-то: decided to go.
Базовая лексика об учёбе: school, university, student, teacher, subject, classroom.
После want идёт инфинитив с to: I want to learn more.

data.transcript: My school is near the park.
data.translation: Моя школа рядом с парком.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: My school is near the park.
My school is in the park.
My office is near the park.
My school is far from the park.
data.explanation: near the park — рядом с парком.

data.prompt: Say: 'I enjoy studying English.'
data.target: I enjoy studying English.
data.explanation: enjoy studying — получать удовольствие от учёбы.

description.ru: Языки и навыки; good at -ing
description.en: Languages and skills; good at -ing

data.question: She is good at ____ languages.
data.explanation: good at + -ing: good at learning — хорошо даётся изучение.

data.text: I am interested ____ learning Spanish.
data.explanation: interested in doing — интересоваться чем-то: interested in learning.

data.question: Переведи: 'Я хорошо говорю по-английски.'
expected: I speak English well.
I am good at speaking English.
I speak good English.
data.hint: speak ... well или be good at speaking.
data.explanation: speak English well — говорить хорошо; good at speaking English — хорошо даётся речь.
want to learn — хотеть учить: He wants to learn French.

data.transcript: I practise speaking every day.
data.translation: Я практикую речь каждый день.
data.question: What did you hear?
data.explanation: practise speaking every day — практиковать речь каждый день.

data.prompt: Say: 'I am good at learning languages.'
data.target: I am good at learning languages.
data.explanation: good at learning — способность к изучению.

description.ru: Обучение навыкам; курсы и практика
description.en: Learning skills; courses and practice

data.question: I signed up for a course ____ improve my writing.
data.explanation: to + глагол показывает цель: a course to improve — курс, чтобы улучшить.
Лексика курсов: course, skill, lesson, practice, homework, certificate.

data.text: He keeps ____ every morning to get better.
data.explanation: keep + -ing — продолжать делать: keep practising.
started learning — начал учиться; learn to code — учиться программировать.

data.prompt: Say: 'I want to learn a new skill.'
data.target: I want to learn a new skill.
data.explanation: want to learn a new skill — хотеть освоить новый навык.

data.transcript: The course starts next week.
data.translation: Курс начинается на следующей неделе.
data.question: What did you hear?
data.explanation: starts next week — начинается на следующей неделе.

description.ru: Подготовка к экзаменам; герундий и инфинитив
description.en: Exam preparation; gerunds and infinitives

data.question: I need ____ hard to pass the exam.
data.hint: После need обычно инфинитив с to.
data.explanation: need to do — нужно сделать: need to study hard.

data.text: She finished ____ for the test at midnight.
data.explanation: finish + -ing — закончить делать: finished studying.
exam, grade, pass, fail, result, mark — лексика об экзаменах.

data.question: Переведи: 'Я хочу сдать экзамен.'
expected: I want to pass the exam.
I want to pass the test.
I would like to pass the exam.
data.explanation: want to pass the exam — хотеть сдать экзамен.

data.transcript: I got a good grade in maths.
data.translation: Я получил хорошую оценку по математике.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: I got a good grade in maths.
I got a bad grade in maths.
I got a good grade in music.
I got a good mark in maths.
data.explanation: a good grade in maths — хорошая оценка по математике.

data.prompt: Say: 'I need to prepare for the exam.'
data.target: I need to prepare for the exam.
data.explanation: need to prepare — нужно подготовиться.

description.ru: Решения и планы; decide to study
description.en: Decisions and plans; decide to study

data.question: We decided ____ a new language this year.
data.hint: После decide идёт инфинитив с to.
data.explanation: decide to do — решить сделать: decided to study.

data.text: I am planning ____ take an online course next month.
data.explanation: plan to do — планировать сделать: planning to take.
hope to do — надеяться сделать: She hopes to study abroad.

I decided to learn programming.
I have decided to study programming.

data.prompt: Say: 'I decided to study every evening.'
data.target: I decided to study every evening.

data.transcript: I plan to finish the course by June.

options: I plan to finish the course by June.
I plan to start the course by June.

I hope to finish the course by June.

online course, video lesson, quiz, deadline, platform, feedback — лексика онлайн-образования.
prefer + -ing — предпочитать: I prefer learning at home.

I work online in the evenings.
I study at school in the evenings.

data.explanation: study online in the evenings — учиться онлайн по вечерам.

data.prompt: Say: 'I like learning on my phone.'
data.target: I like learning on my phone.
data.explanation: like learning — нравится учиться.

description.en: Goals and aspirations; gerunds and infinitives in speech

keep practising — продолжаю практиковаться; to improve — чтобы улучшить.

description.en: Continuous development; gerunds and infinitives review

data.question: It is never too late ____ something new.

data.explanation: too late to do — слишком поздно, чтобы: too late to learn.

data.text: I believe in ____ throughout your whole life.
data.explanation: believe in + -ing — верить в: believe in learning.
knowledge, experience, develop, curious, progress, improve — лексика саморазвития.

data.question: Переведи: 'Я продолжаю учиться, чтобы расти.'
expected: I keep learning to grow.
I continue learning to grow.
I keep on learning to grow.
data.explanation: keep learning to grow — продолжаю учиться, чтобы расти.

data.transcript: Learning never stops in life.

data.prompt: Say: 'I want to keep learning all my life.'
data.target: I want to keep learning all my life.

description.ru: Знакомимся со страдательным залогом: is/are + причастие
description.en: Meeting the passive: is/are + past participle

data.transcript: The forest is protected by law.
data.translation: Лес охраняется законом.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: The forest is protected by law.
The forest was protected by law.
The forest is not protected by law.
data.explanation: «is protected» = «охраняется». Действие происходит с лесом.

data.question: Many trees ____ in spring.
data.explanation: Пассив в настоящем: are + planted. «Деревья сажают весной».

data.text: Rain ____ formed from water vapour.
data.explanation: Пассив: is + formed. «Дождь образуется из водяного пара».
Запомни эти слова — они встретятся во всех уроках модуля.
«The mountains are covered with snow» — «Горы покрыты снегом».

data.prompt: Say: 'Rivers are found all over the world.'
data.target: Rivers are found all over the world.

«The ocean is polluted by plastic» — «Океан загрязняется пластиком».

expected: The air is polluted
Air is polluted

Plastic is collected in this city.
Plastic was recycled in this city.

data.question: Glass bottles ____ recycled easily.

expected: Paper is recycled
The paper is recycled

description.ru: Как производят и используют энергию: пассив
description.en: How energy is produced and used: the passive

data.question: Electricity ____ produced by wind turbines.

«Coal is burned to make electricity» — «Уголь сжигают, чтобы производить электричество».

data.prompt: Say: 'Clean energy is produced by solar panels.'

Gas is used to cool homes.
Gas was used to heat homes.

description.ru: Защита животных; появляется пассив прошедшего времени

Many animals are hunted in national parks.
Many animals protect the national parks.
Many animals were protected in national parks.
data.explanation: «are protected» — «находятся под защитой».

data.question: Pandas ____ protected by international law.
data.explanation: «Pandas are protected by international law» — «Панды защищены международным законом».

data.text: The tiger ____ hunted for its skin in the past.

data.question: Переведи: 'Многие животные находятся под защитой.'
expected: Many animals are protected
A lot of animals are protected
data.explanation: Пассив в настоящем: «Many animals are protected».
«These birds were saved by scientists» — «Этих птиц спасли учёные».

data.prompt: Say: 'Wild animals are protected in this forest.'
data.target: Wild animals are protected in this forest.
data.explanation: «Дикие животные находятся под защитой в этом лесу».

description.ru: Изменение климата и его причины в страдательном залоге
description.en: Climate change and its causes in the passive

data.question: Global warming ____ caused by greenhouse gases.
data.explanation: «Global warming is caused by greenhouse gases» — «Глобальное потепление вызвано парниковыми газами».

data.text: The climate ____ changed by human activity.
data.explanation: «The climate is changed by human activity» — «Климат меняется из-за деятельности человека».
Эти слова описывают причины и последствия изменения климата.
«The ice is melted by rising temperatures» — «Лёд тает из-за роста температуры».

data.question: Переведи: 'Климат меняется из-за людей.'
expected: The climate is changed by people
Climate is changed by humans
The climate is changed by humans

data.explanation: «Земля нагревается солнцем». Пассив с агентом «by the sun».

description.ru: Экопривычки: настоящий и прошедший пассив вместе
description.en: Eco-habits: present and past passive together

data.transcript: Reusable bags are used instead of plastic ones.
data.translation: Многоразовые сумки используются вместо пластиковых.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: Reusable bags are used instead of plastic ones.
Reusable bags are sold instead of plastic ones.
Reusable bags were used instead of plastic ones.
data.explanation: «are used instead of» — «используются вместо».

data.question: In the past, less energy ____ wasted at home.
data.explanation: «Less energy was wasted at home» — «Раньше дома тратили меньше энергии».

data.text: Water ____ saved when we turn off the tap.
data.explanation: «Water is saved» — «Вода экономится, когда мы закрываем кран».
«These clothes are made from recycled materials» — «Эта одежда сделана из переработанных материалов».

data.question: Переведи: 'Эти дома построены из натуральных материалов.'
expected: These houses are built from natural materials
These houses are made of natural materials
These houses are built of natural materials
data.explanation: Пассив в настоящем: «These houses are built from natural materials».

data.prompt: Say: 'Energy is saved by switching off the lights.'
data.target: Energy is saved by switching off the lights.
data.explanation: «Энергия экономится, если выключать свет». После «by» идёт форма с -ing.

description.ru: Пассив процессов: шаг за шагом описываем производство
description.en: The process passive: describing production step by step

data.question: First, the beans ____ picked by hand.
data.hint: «beans» во множественном числе, описание процесса в настоящем.
data.explanation: «The beans are picked by hand» — «Сначала бобы собирают вручную».

data.text: Then the coffee ____ dried in the sun.
data.explanation: «The coffee is dried in the sun» — «Затем кофе сушат на солнце».
В пассиве: is produced, is picked, is dried, is packed, is transported, is sold.
«The chocolate is packed and sent to shops» — «Шоколад упаковывают и отправляют в магазины».

data.prompt: Say: 'The bottles are filled and then labelled.'
data.target: The bottles are filled and then labelled.
data.explanation: «Бутылки наполняют, а затем наклеивают этикетки». Цепочка пассива в процессе.

data.transcript: The product is checked before it is sold.
data.translation: Продукт проверяется перед продажей.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: The product is checked before it is sold.
The product is packed before it is sold.
The product checks before it is sold.
The product was checked before it is sold.
data.explanation: «is checked before it is sold» — «проверяется, прежде чем его продадут». Два пассива в одном предложении.

description.ru: Present Perfect для опыта, ever и never
description.en: Present Perfect for experience, ever and never

data.question: ____ you ever been to London?
data.hint: Present Perfect: have/has + V3. Подлежащее you.
data.explanation: С you, we, they, I используем have. Полная форма вопроса: Have you ever been…?

data.text: I have never ____ sushi in my life.
data.explanation: eat — ate — eaten. После have/never ставим причастие прошедшего времени: have never eaten.

data.hint: Соедини инфинитив с его третьей формой (V3).
data.explanation: Эти неправильные глаголы часто нужны в Present Perfect: have gone, have seen, have eaten и т. д.

data.hint: Порядок в вопросе: Have + подлежащее + ever + V3.
data.explanation: ever ('когда-либо') стоит между подлежащим и причастием: Have you ever ridden a horse?

data.transcript: Have you ever been abroad?
data.translation: Ты когда-нибудь был за границей?
data.question: What did you hear?
data.hint: abroad = за границей. Слушай начало: Have you ever…
data.explanation: Вопрос об опыте в Present Perfect: Have you ever been abroad? — 'Ты когда-нибудь был за границей?'

data.prompt: Say: 'I have never broken a bone.'
data.target: I have never broken a bone.
data.explanation: 'Я никогда не ломал кость.' never делает предложение отрицательным, поэтому not не нужно.

description.ru: Наречия недавнего времени в Present Perfect
description.en: Recent-time adverbs in Present Perfect

data.question: Choose the correct sentence.
data.hint: yet ставится в конце вопроса или отрицания.
data.explanation: yet ('уже/ещё') идёт в конец: Have you finished yet? В отрицании — I haven't finished yet.

data.text: I have already ____ this film twice, let's watch another one.
data.explanation: see — saw — seen. already ('уже') стоит между have и причастием: have already seen.

data.question: Переведи: 'Я только что позвонил маме.'
expected: I have just called my mum.
I've just called my mum.
I have just called my mom.
data.hint: just = 'только что', ставится перед V3. call — called.
data.explanation: just показывает, что действие произошло совсем недавно: I have just called…
leave — left. 'Поезд уже ушёл': The train has already left.

data.transcript: I've already eaten, thanks.
data.translation: Я уже поел, спасибо.
data.question: What did you hear?
data.hint: I've = I have. Слушай already + eaten.
data.explanation: I've already eaten — 'Я уже поел.' already подчёркивает, что действие завершено раньше ожидаемого.

data.prompt: Say: 'She hasn't arrived yet.'
data.target: She hasn't arrived yet.
data.hint: hasn't = has not. yet в конце отрицания.
data.explanation: 'Она ещё не приехала.' В отрицаниях yet означает 'ещё (не)' и стоит в конце.

description.ru: Present Perfect для результатов и достижений
description.en: Present Perfect for results and achievements

data.question: She ____ a marathon three times.
data.hint: She → has. run — ran — run (V3 = run).
data.explanation: Present Perfect: has + run. У глагола run третья форма тоже run: has run.

data.text: He has ____ his driving test at last!
data.explanation: pass ('сдать экзамен') — правильный глагол: has passed. at last = 'наконец-то'.

data.hint: Соедини английскую фразу с её переводом.
data.explanation: Это типичные достижения, о которых говорят в Present Perfect: I have won a prize, She has passed an exam…

data.question: Переведи: 'Я научился играть на гитаре.'
expected: I have learned to play the guitar.
I've learned to play the guitar.
I have learnt to play the guitar.
data.hint: learn — learned/learnt. play the guitar (с the).
data.explanation: Достижение без конкретной даты → Present Perfect: I have learned to play the guitar.

data.hint: win — won. Порядок: подлежащее + have + won + …
data.explanation: 'Мы выиграли кубок в этом году': We have won the cup this year. this year — период ещё не закончился.

data.prompt: Say: 'I have achieved my goal.'
data.target: I have achieved my goal.
data.explanation: 'Я достиг своей цели.' Present Perfect подчёркивает результат, важный сейчас.

description.ru: for для длительности, since для начала
description.en: for for duration, since for a starting point

data.question: I have lived in this city ____ 2019.
data.hint: Точка начала (год, день) → since. Отрезок времени → for.
data.explanation: since указывает момент начала: since 2019. for указывает длительность: for five years.

data.text: We have known each other ____ three years.
data.explanation: for + длительность (three years, a long time). since + момент (Monday, 2019).

data.hint: Момент начала → since, отрезок длительности → for.
data.explanation: since 2019 / since Monday / since I was a child (моменты). for three years / for a long time / for two weeks (длительность).
'Она работает здесь с мая': She has worked here since May. Ситуация началась в мае и продолжается.

data.transcript: They have been married for ten years.
data.translation: Они женаты уже десять лет.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: They have been married for ten years.
They have been married for ten weeks.
They were married ten years ago.
They will be married for ten years.
data.hint: married = 'в браке'. Слушай число и слово after 'for'.
data.explanation: for ten years — длительность до сих пор: 'Они женаты уже десять лет.'

data.prompt: Say: 'I have studied English since childhood.'
data.target: I have studied English since childhood.
data.explanation: 'Я учу английский с детства.' since childhood указывает момент начала ситуации.

description.ru: Разница между have been и have gone
description.en: The difference between have been and have gone

data.question: Anna isn't here. She has ____ to the shops.
data.hint: Она сейчас там, ещё не вернулась → gone.
data.explanation: has gone = ушёл и всё ещё там. has been = был и уже вернулся. Анны нет → she has gone.

data.text: I have ____ to Italy twice; I loved it both times.
data.hint: Речь об опыте, ты уже вернулся → been.
data.explanation: have been to = 'бывал(а) в' (и вернулся). have gone to = 'уехал туда' (и сейчас там).

data.question: Переведи: 'Он уехал в Париж.' (его сейчас нет здесь)
expected: He has gone to Paris.
He's gone to Paris.
data.hint: Он сейчас там → have/has gone to.
data.explanation: gone показывает, что человек уехал и находится там сейчас: He has gone to Paris.

data.hint: Опыт → been. ever между подлежащим и причастием.
data.explanation: 'Ты когда-нибудь был в Японии?': Have you ever been to Japan? Здесь речь об опыте, поэтому been.

data.transcript: My parents have gone to the airport.
data.translation: Мои родители уехали в аэропорт.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: My parents have gone to the airport.
My parents have been to the airport.
My parents are going to the airport.
My parents went to the airport.
data.hint: gone → они сейчас там. Слушай been vs gone.
data.explanation: have gone to the airport — родители уехали и ещё в пути/там: 'Мои родители уехали в аэропорт.'

data.prompt: Say: 'I have never been to America.'
data.target: I have never been to America.
data.explanation: 'Я никогда не был в Америке.' Когда говорим об опыте, используем been, а не gone.

description.ru: Present Perfect для свежих новостей и перемен
description.en: Present Perfect for fresh news and changes

data.question: Great news! The company ____ a new product.
data.hint: Свежая новость без даты → Present Perfect.
data.explanation: Для новостей, важных сейчас, берём Present Perfect: has launched a new product.

data.text: Prices have ____ a lot this year.
data.hint: rise — rose — risen. Речь об изменении.
data.explanation: rise ('расти') — неправильный глагол: have risen. Изменение продолжается в текущем году → Present Perfect.

data.hint: Соедини глагол с его третьей формой (V3).
data.explanation: Эти V3 часто нужны в новостях: has become, has grown, has bought, has made, has broken, has given.

data.hint: change — changed. Простой порядок: подлежащее + has + changed.
data.explanation: 'Город сильно изменился': The city has changed a lot. Результат виден сейчас → Present Perfect.

data.transcript: My sister has got a new job.
data.translation: Моя сестра нашла новую работу.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: My sister has got a new job.
My sister is getting a new job.
My sister had a new job.
My sister wants a new job.
data.hint: has got = получила/нашла. Слушай начало и время.
data.explanation: has got a new job — новость с результатом в настоящем: 'Моя сестра нашла новую работу.'

data.prompt: Say: 'They have moved to a new house.'
data.target: They have moved to a new house.
data.explanation: 'Они переехали в новый дом.' Изменение с результатом в настоящем → Present Perfect.

description.ru: Present Perfect против Past Simple
description.en: Present Perfect vs Past Simple

data.question: I ____ my keys yesterday, but I found them this morning.
data.explanation: Маркер конкретного времени (yesterday) требует Past Simple: I lost my keys yesterday.

data.text: She has visited Rome, but she ____ Venice last summer.
data.hint: last summer — конкретное время → Past Simple.
data.explanation: Опыт без даты → has visited. Но с last summer нужен Past Simple: visited.

data.question: Переведи: 'Я видел этот фильм на прошлой неделе.'
expected: I saw this film last week.
I saw this movie last week.
I watched this film last week.
data.hint: last week — конкретное прошлое → Past Simple. see — saw.
data.explanation: Указано когда (last week), поэтому Past Simple: I saw this film last week.

data.hint: Маркеры конкретного времени → Past Simple; ever/already/just → Present Perfect.
data.explanation: yesterday, in 2010, ago задают точное время (Past Simple). ever, already, just связаны с настоящим (Present Perfect).

data.hint: Опыт (have met) + конкретный факт в прошлом (forgot).
data.explanation: 'Мы встречались раньше, но я забыл твоё имя': опыт → have met; завершённое действие → forgot (Past Simple).

data.prompt: Say: 'I have been to Berlin, but I went there in 2015.'

data.hint: Опыт → have been; конкретный год → went (Past Simple).
data.explanation: 'Я был в Берлине, но ездил туда в 2015.' Опыт без даты — Present Perfect; с датой — Past Simple.

description.ru: Опыт и достижения в связной речи
description.en: Experience and achievements in connected speech

data.question: In a job interview: 'I ____ for this company for two years, and last year I led a big project.'

data.text: I have always ____ of living abroad one day.
data.explanation: have always dreamed = 'всегда мечтал(а)'. always ставится между have и причастием.

data.question: Переведи: 'Я много путешествовал и выучил три языка.'
expected: I have travelled a lot and learned three languages.
I've travelled a lot and learnt three languages.
I have traveled a lot and learned three languages.
data.hint: Опыт без даты → Present Perfect: have travelled, (have) learned.
data.explanation: Жизненный опыт без указания когда → Present Perfect: I have travelled a lot and learned three languages.

data.hint: give up — give — given. never + V3.
data.explanation: 'Я никогда не отказывался от своей мечты': I have never given up on my dreams.

data.transcript: I have grown a lot as a person.
data.translation: Я сильно вырос как личность.

options: I have grown a lot as a person.
I have grown a lot as a parent.
I am growing a lot as a person.
I grew a lot as a person.
data.hint: grow — grew — grown. Слушай grown и as a person.
data.explanation: have grown a lot as a person — изменение с результатом в настоящем: 'Я сильно вырос как личность.'

data.prompt: Say: 'I have learned a lot, and I am proud of what I have achieved.'
data.target: I have learned a lot, and I am proud of what I have achieved.
data.hint: Два Present Perfect: have learned, have achieved.
data.explanation: 'Я многому научился и горжусь тем, чего достиг.' Present Perfect связывает прошлый опыт с настоящим результатом.

description.ru: Прошлые привычки с 'used to' и как они изменились

data.text: She ____ to have long hair, but now it is short.

'We used to walk to school every day.' — регулярная привычка в прошлом.

pairs.left: Did you use to play football?
She used to eat a lot of meat.

data.hint: В вопросах и отрицаниях 'use to' без -d.
data.explanation: После 'did' и 'didn't' форма без окончания: 'did you use to', 'we didn't use to'.

data.transcript: I used to go running every morning before work.
data.translation: Раньше я бегал каждое утро перед работой.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: I used to go running every morning before work.
I usually go running every morning after work.
I used to go swimming every evening before work.
I used to go walking every morning before lunch.
data.hint: Слушай глагол движения и время суток.
data.explanation: 'used to go running' — прошлая привычка бегать по утрам.

data.translation: Мы посетили город, чьи улицы всегда полны музыки.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: a town whose streets are full of music
a town who streets are full of music
a town which streets are full of music
a music whose town is full of streets
data.explanation: Whose показывает принадлежность: a town whose streets...

description.ru: Смешение who/which/that/where/whose
description.en: Mixing who/which/that/where/whose

data.question: The hike ___ we did last summer was unforgettable.
data.explanation: That вводит придаточное о вещи/событии: the hike that we did.

data.text: That was the moment ____ I felt truly free.
data.explanation: When вводит придаточное о времени: the moment when I felt free.

data.question: Переведи: 'Это самое красивое место, которое я видел.'
expected: This is the most beautiful place that I've seen.
It's the most beautiful place I have seen.
This is the most beautiful place which I have seen.
data.explanation: После the most... обычно используем that.

data.transcript: The day which I remember most was our trip to the mountains.
data.translation: День, который я помню лучше всего, — наша поездка в горы.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: the day which I remember most
the day who I remember most
the day where I remember most
the mountains which remember the day
data.explanation: Which/that вводит придаточное о вещи: the day which I remember.

data.prompt: Say: 'That trip is something I will never forget.'
data.target: That trip is something I will never forget.

That changed my life описывает an experience.

description.ru: Определяющие придаточные: объединение предложений
description.en: Defining clauses: combining sentences

data.explanation: That/which вводит определяющее придаточное о вещи/организации.

data.text: The suitcase ____ I lost at the airport was never found.
data.hint: Определяющее придаточное о вещи; that можно опустить
data.explanation: The suitcase (that) I lost — that как дополнение можно опустить.

pairs.left: the driver whose car broke down

data.explanation: Разные относительные слова описывают людей, вещи, места, время.
That we ordered описывает the taxi; главное сказуемое — never arrived.

data.prompt: Say: 'The company that sold us the tickets never replied.'

data.question: What did you hear?

the guide which was supposed to meet us
the guide where was supposed to meet us
the guide whose supposed to meet us
data.explanation: Who вводит определяющее придаточное о человеке: the guide who...

description.ru: Описание мест через which/that
description.en: Describing places with which/that

data.explanation: Когда 'город' — подлежащее придаточного, берём which/that: a city which has...

data.text: The valley ____ we drove through was the most stunning view of all.
data.explanation: The valley (that) we drove through — that как дополнение можно опустить.

data.question: Переведи: 'Это остров, который знаменит своими пляжами.'
expected: This is an island that is famous for its beaches.

This is an island famous for its beaches.
data.explanation: Which/that вводит придаточное, где остров — подлежащее.

data.translation: Моё любимое место — рынок, который продаёт свежие специи.
data.question: What did you hear?
options: the market which sells fresh spices
the market who sells fresh spices
the market where sells fresh spices
the spices which sell fresh market
data.explanation: Which вводит придаточное, где market — подлежащее: which sells...

data.prompt: Say: 'The best beach is the one that has golden sand.'

description.ru: Лексика резюме и Present Perfect для опыта
description.en: CV vocabulary and Present Perfect for experience

data.question: I ____ as a project manager for five years.

data.explanation: 'For five years' + опыт до сих пор → have worked (Present Perfect).

data.explanation: Cover letter — сопроводительное письмо к резюме.

data.explanation: Базовая лексика раздела 'резюме и опыт'.

data.translation: У меня три года опыта в маркетинге.

I had three years of experience in marketing.
I have three jobs of experience in marketing.

Because it is near my house.

data.text: Tell me about your strengths and your ____.
data.explanation: Strengths and weaknesses — сильные и слабые стороны, классический вопрос.

options: Can you tell me about yourself?
Can you tell me about your salary?
Can you sell me about yourself?
Could you tell me about your self?

I am in charge of marketing.

I work on two projects every moment.

I work in two projects at the moment.

The meeting has been removed on Friday.
The meeting has been booked for Friday.

Устойчивые формулы делового письма.

Thank you for your letter.
Thanks for your email.
data.explanation: Thank you for your email/letter — стандартное начало ответа.

data.prompt: Say: 'Please let me know if you have any questions.'
data.target: Please let me know if you have any questions.
data.explanation: Частая финальная фраза делового письма.

data.explanation: Put someone through — соединить с кем-то по телефону.

Speak up — говорить громче; вежливая просьба по телефону.

data.translation: Боюсь, её сейчас нет на месте.

options: I'm afraid she's not available right now.
I'm afraid she's not available right away.
I'm afraid he's not available right now.
I'm afraid she's now available right now.

I will send you the emails tomorrow.
I will send you the details today.
I will lend you the details tomorrow.
data.explanation: Will для обещания/решения, принятого в момент речи.

data.explanation: Так формулируют карьерную цель на будущее.
